name: bluesky-mcp-server
description: Search Bluesky posts and feeds; read profiles, threads, and trends. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

BLUESKY_CLAMP_READ_LIMITS.title: Clamp read limits
BLUESKY_CLAMP_READ_LIMITS.description: Clamp oversized read limits with a notice; false restores rejection.

BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER.title: Bluesky handle (for post search)
BLUESKY_IDENTIFIER.description: Optional. The account post search runs as — use a dedicated one. Leave blank (with the app password) and every other tool still works; only post search is left out.

BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD.title: Bluesky app password (for post search)
BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD.description: Optional. A standard, non-privileged app password for that account (Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords). Set it together with the handle.
